header.name: InvUI for Bedrock Resource Pack (EXPERIMENTAL / UNVERIFIED)
header.description: EXPERIMENTAL, ENABLED BY DEFAULT, NOT VERIFIED IN-GAME. ui/_ui_defs.json registers invui.json, invui_connect.json and invui_connect_data_driven.json. The connection inserts the invui_probe overlay and a transparent grid blocker into data_driven_container.desktop_panel and pocket_panel, so it may affect ALL screens that use those panels (possibly ordinary containers), not only VirtualContainer; vanilla chest_screen is not edited. The blocker may also restrict buttons and inventory slots, and there is no guarantee that it blocks player-side inventory or controller input; while VirtualContainer uses this screen is unconfirmed, other screens may also be affected, and no close handling is implemented. The probe button is not wired to any script. The pack version [0,1,0] and min_engine_version [1,26,70] are placeholders; the matching game version is unconfirmed. Test only in a disposable world with backups.
